title: A player without a confirmed country cannot move money, and is told how to fix it
summary: Phase 404.1 gives every player a trusted country at sign-up. When the country could not be resolved (sentinel ZZ) every money gate refuses, and the wallet says why and links to identity verification instead of showing a raw error.
sources: 404.1-VERIFICATION.md success criterion 3 (NULL/ZZ refuses everywhere: deposit/withdrawal 403 COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED)
apps/player-web/src/components/wallet/DepositForm.tsx:80-82, WithdrawForm.tsx:61-68 (localised codes + KYC call to action)

accounts.zz_player: a signed-in player whose kyc.player_kyc_status country is ZZ / source unresolved (provisioned through the API before the run; never by SQL)
accounts.ng_player: a signed-in player whose country is NG / source ip

steps.say: A player whose country could not be confirmed opens the deposit page
steps.expect: The deposit form renders with an amount field and a payment method

steps.say: They try to deposit and are refused with a plain explanation

do.text: Complete identity verification to set your country before depositing.

steps.expect: The message 'Complete identity verification to set your country before depositing.' and a link to identity verification; no balance change

steps.say: Withdrawal is refused the same way

do.text: Complete identity verification to set your country before withdrawing.

steps.expect: The message 'Complete identity verification to set your country before withdrawing.' and the identity-verification link

steps.say: The link takes them to identity verification

do.target: identity verification link in the refusal message

steps.say: A player with a confirmed country is not stopped by the country gate
steps.expect: No country message; the deposit proceeds to the payment step
